title: Juniper and the Alibi
author: Marguerite Ishikawa
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
